member.name: T:IssueAgent.Providers.MarkdownAttachmentScanner
member.summary: Extracts candidate attachment links from human-authored Markdown bodies. IssueAgent never crawls ordinary webpages; only Markdown-embedded image/link syntax pointing at provider-owned attachment endpoints or obvious direct-file HTTP(S) URLs is considered.

member.name: M:IssueAgent.Providers.MarkdownAttachmentScanner.MarkdownLinkPattern
member.remarks:
Pattern:
!?\\[[^\\]]*\\]\\((?<url>https?://[^\\s)]+)\\)
Options:
RegexOptions.CultureInvariant
Explanation:
○ Match '!' atomically, optionally.
○ Match '['.
○ Match a character other than ']' atomically any number of times.
○ Match the string "](".
○ "url" capture group.
○ Match the string "http".
○ Match 's' atomically, optionally.
○ Match the string "://".
○ Match a character in the set [^)\s] atomically at least once.
○ Match ')'.

member.name: M:IssueAgent.Providers.MarkdownAttachmentScanner.BareUrlPattern
member.remarks:
Pattern:
(?<!\\()https?://[^\\s)>\\]]+
Options:
RegexOptions.CultureInvariant
Explanation:
○ Zero-width negative lookbehind.
○ Match '(' right-to-left.
○ Match the string "http".
○ Match 's' atomically, optionally.
○ Match the string "://".
○ Match a character in the set [^)>]\s] atomically at least once.
